text: Coffee with Esme. Her puppy Biscuit arrived Saturday and has already eaten one of her trainers. She's flying to Lisbon next Tuesday so her brother Rhys is dog-sitting. Text her that morning to say safe travels.

Long catch-up with Patrick and Nora. They're off to Japan for three weeks from Friday, fourteen hour flight via Helsinki. Nora's a bit anxious about leaving her mum, who's been poorly. Patrick says the cat's going to his sister's, and he's already made a laminated feeding schedule. They want to do dinner when they're back, maybe the Saturday after. I should drop off the guidebook before Friday.
Aneesh's cat Pickle is at the vet tomorrow for a dental. He sounded really worried. Ring him the next day to see how she got on.
Svetlana called. Her daughter graduates in a fortnight and the whole family is driving to Edinburgh the day before. She's mad about knitting at the moment, making scarves for everyone.
Isaac and Kiara were meant to be going to Morocco this weekend but it's off, Kiara's dad had a fall. Isaac said they'll rebook for spring. Must send Kiara something, maybe flowers, before Thursday.
Bought dog food, picked up the parcel, booked the car in for Monday.
Miriam's dog Pepper turns ten on Sunday! She's doing a little party in the park with sausages. Apparently Pepper loves squeaky hedgehogs, could get one.
Quick call with Karan. Back from Delhi last night, said the flight was brutal and he barely slept. Starts his new job on Monday. Message him Monday evening to see how the first day went.
Chen Wang mentioned he's thinking of getting a rescue greyhound. Works from home now, so it would suit him. He's vegetarian, keep in mind for Saturday.

Met up with Divya, Emily and Eli at the pub. Divya is moving to Bristol at the end of the month, Emily is pregnant (due in March!), and Eli has a half marathon next Sunday that he's properly nervous about. Text Eli good luck the night before. Emily said she's off coffee completely.
I'm flying to Bucharest on Thursday for my cousin's wedding, back the following Tuesday.
Sinead's cat Mungo went missing on Wednesday. She's in bits, put posters up everywhere. Check in with her tomorrow.

Grace said Hiroshi has been offered a placement in Osaka for six months, leaving in January. She's thrilled for him but dreading the long distance. Their anniversary is the week after he goes. She's thinking of surprising him with a visit in February but hasn't booked anything. Hiroshi's been learning Japanese on the train every morning, bless him.
Need to post Antoine's birthday card by Wednesday so it reaches Lyon in time. His birthday's Saturday.

Bogdan and Jaya came round. They've just got two kittens, Salt and Pepper, from her colleague's litter. Bogdan's allergic but taking antihistamines and pretending he's fine. Jaya's off to Singapore for work next Monday for ten days, so he's on kitten duty alone. Should pop round midweek and help.
Zara mentioned her grandad's ninetieth is this Saturday, big lunch at a hotel in Harrogate. She's going up Friday night.
Yaw rang about the trip. We're all meeting at Gatwick at 6am on the 3rd. He's sorting the car, I'm doing snacks.
Thomas's mum has her hip op on Tuesday. He's taking the week off to look after her. Remember to call him a few days after.
Sadia is totally obsessed with bouldering now, goes four times a week. She and Khadija are planning a climbing holiday in Kalymnos next summer.
Khadija's rabbit Clover had to be put to sleep yesterday. She's really upset, she'd had her eleven years. Send her a card.
Luis back from Mexico, says his grandmother's doing better and the family loved seeing him. He brought back loads of coffee. Hasn't unpacked yet.
Caitlin got the puppy!! Cocker spaniel called Fig. First vet jabs next Thursday and puppy classes start the week after. She's not sleeping much.

Aditi said her husband Anan is flying out to Bangkok on Friday because his father's very ill. She and the kids might follow next week if things get worse. She's holding it together but only just. Ring her over the weekend. Don't forget to offer to have the kids after school.
Lunch with Rhys. He's training for the Snowdon race in a fortnight, and his partner Esme thinks he's mad. Their dog Bramble is coming along to cheer.
Note to self: renew passport before the Canada trip, ideally this week.
Sinead says her nephew starts uni in Galway on Monday. Her sister is a mess about it.
Patrick Baker wants to meet for a pint next Wednesday after work. He's got news about the job apparently, sounded excited.
Miriam's flight to Sydney got cancelled so she's going Thursday instead, via Dubai. Twenty-three hours. She hates flying and is dreading it. Message her the day she lands.
Esme said Biscuit has worms, vet tomorrow morning.

Caught up with Karan and his wife Divya. Their little boy Arjun has his first school play on Friday afternoon, he's a sheep. Karan is weirdly more nervous than Arjun. Divya's mum is visiting from Pune that weekend and staying a month, so they're clearing out the spare room. Divya said she'd love a decent cookbook for her mum, something vegetarian. I should ask Karan the next day how the play went.
Called Svetlana back about Christmas. She's hosting fourteen and slightly panicking. Her oven is broken too. Offer to bring a dessert.
Zara told me she and Ioana have pushed the wedding to next September, venue fell through. Still keen on Romania, where Ioana's family is.
Kiara is coeliac, I keep forgetting. Dinner at hers is Saturday, I'm bringing wine.
Hiroshi rang from Tokyo. Weather is gorgeous, he's eaten ramen every day. Back on Tuesday. Grace is picking him up from Heathrow that morning and then they're straight off to her parents' for lunch.
Should send Nora the photos from the beach day before she flies.
Isaac's daughter Maya has her grade 3 piano exam on Thursday, she's been practising like mad. He said she gets really nervous. Ask him Friday how it went.
Eli did the half in 1:52!! So chuffed for him. He's already eyeing up Berlin next year. Must message him congrats.

Had a walk with Chen and his dog Toffee. Toffee's got a limp so they're seeing the vet Monday. Chen's sister Lily is coming over from Shanghai in a fortnight, first visit in five years. He's planning to take her to the Lakes the weekend after she lands. He seemed happy but tired, work's been relentless.
Divya's moving date confirmed: Saturday the 31st. Van booked. I said I'd help load on the Friday evening.
Aneesh says Pickle is fine after the dental, lost two teeth but eating again. Phew.
Bogdan's birthday is next Sunday. He keeps going on about wanting a proper espresso machine, hint taken.
Jaya is in Singapore and loving it, apparently the hotel has a rooftop pool. She lands Thursday. Bogdan's taking her for dinner the next night.
Sadia mentioned her boss is retiring at Christmas and she might apply for his role. Interviews are early December. She's unsure if she's ready.
Antoine's dog Rocco had surgery on his knee last week. He's on crate rest for six weeks and Antoine is going stir crazy. Need to drop round with treats this weekend.

FaceTimed Zara and her girlfriend Ioana. They've booked a cabin in Norway for New Year, ferry from Newcastle on the 28th. Zara's terrified of the crossing, Ioana can't wait. Ioana also mentioned she's started a pottery course on Wednesday nights.
Thomas says his mum's op went well and she's home. Walking with a frame. He's going back to work Monday.
Yaw's sister Abena is getting married in Accra in March. He's flying out a week before to help. Remind me to ask him which date exactly.

Long chat with Emily on the phone. Morning sickness has been awful, she's lost weight and the midwife wants to see her again on Tuesday. Her partner Luis is being brilliant though, doing all the cooking. Their twelve week scan is the Friday after. She asked if I'd come over next weekend. Definitely going, and I should bring ginger biscuits.
Grace's cat Nimbus is fourteen tomorrow. She's ordered him a fish cake from a pet bakery, which is very Grace.
Must ring Mrs Fischer about feeding the cats while we're in Crete.

Uncle Patrick's back from his cruise. Said the Norwegian fjords were stunning but the food was dire. Auntie Nora got seasick on day two. He wants us over for Sunday lunch next week to see the photos. Nora's knee is still bad so they're getting a stairlift fitted on Thursday. Patrick asked if I could bring the projector, and Nora wants that lemon tart recipe.

Aditi messaged: Anan's dad passed away on Tuesday. Funeral is in Bangkok on Saturday, she's flying out with the kids Thursday. I need to send flowers to the house before they go and call her a week after when they're back.
Miriam landed safely! Says Sydney is hot and her sister's kids have grown so much.
Isaac says Maya passed with merit, she's over the moon. He's taking her for pizza Friday to celebrate.
Rhys mentioned Esme's dad is having a heart scan next Wednesday. She hasn't said much but he thinks she's quietly worried. I'll text her the evening after.
Caitlin's Fig ate a sock and needed an emergency op on Saturday night. He's recovering fine but she's shattered and the bill was eye-watering. Ask her how he is on Wednesday.
Khadija is going to Istanbul for a week with her mum, flying out next Saturday. First holiday since losing Clover. She asked if I'd water her plants.

Grabbed a coffee with Svetlana and her son Ivan. Ivan is off to Canada on a gap year in January, first time living away. Svetlana is putting on a brave face. He's really into ice hockey, wants to see a Canucks game. Svetlana's husband is flying out with him for the first week to help him settle in. Thinking we could take Ivan for a farewell dinner the weekend before he goes.
Sorted the holiday insurance and paid the deposit for the villa.
Kiara and Isaac rebooked Morocco for April. Her dad's on the mend, out of hospital Friday. She said a hamper would've been nicer than flowers, ha.
